name: PT Gema Grahasarana Tbk
summary: PT Gema Grahasarana Tbk operates as an interior contractor, and furniture manufacturer and distributor in Indonesia and internationally. The company operates through Interior, Furniture, Mechanical and Electrical; and Distribution and Trade segments. It offers interior fit-outs, furniture and panel manufacturing, mechanical and electrical installation, maintenance, and logistics services. The company offers customized wooden furniture, panels, office furniture, metal, and rattan; and home and office furnishing products. Further, it is involved in the trading of laminated material interior and furniture; house, and office furniture and equipment; and interior and furniture components, as well…
